fields.summary_ko.0: GOOGL has declined -5.5% year-to-date, and despite Q3 revenue of $127.6B (up 25% YoY) and 30% net income growth, free cash flow came in at -$9.1B due to AI infrastructure investments.
fields.summary_ko.1: GOOG's 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $195-205B is more than double the prior year, and with a PER of 15.4x showing undervaluation, positive factors include Google Cloud's 103% growth and Search revenue of $63.4B.
